dovish.title: JOLTS Misses Consensus but Rises on Revised Base
dovish.summary: July openings were 7.271M, 29k below consensus but 89k above revised June.
dovish.source: BLS JOLTS via FXStreet / TradingEconomics calendar
dovish.reason: The 29k consensus miss is mildly dovish, but BLS table 1 shows openings rose 89k from revised June 7.182M. The mixed signal merits only 0.5 weight and is retained as historical labour-demand context, not as a claim that openings fell.

dovish.title: ADP Employment Missed Before August Payrolls
dovish.summary: August private payroll growth was 38k, below the 47k consensus.
dovish.reason: The modest 9k private-payroll miss was a weak preliminary signal, later superseded by the official August payroll rebound. It remains at 1.0 as limited historical context rather than a pending-payroll catalyst.
